name: ForensiBEC synthetic research corpus
provenance: SYNTHETIC - generated from parameterised templates by data/build_research_corpus.py. No real mailbox, person, organisation or financial detail is represented.
split_strategy: stratified 60/20/20 by label, deterministic under seed

interpretation.valid_use: Measuring whether engineered features are learnable and which evidence families carry separable signal (ablation).
interpretation.invalid_use: Estimating real-world detection accuracy. Template-generated data has learnable generative structure, so results are an OPTIMISTIC UPPER BOUND, not a performance estimate.

difficulty_controls: ~40% of benign messages carry legitimate urgency and/or payment language (confounded benigns)
~30% of malicious messages omit urgency and explicit amounts, relying on identity evidence only (subtle malicious)
~28% of malicious messages are sent from a COMPROMISED but genuine mailbox: real domain, SPF/DKIM/DMARC all pass, no lookalike. Only behavioural, stylometric and financial evidence can reach these
~30% of external benign messages are relayed or forwarded and SOFTFAIL SPF, so authentication failure does not imply malicious
greetings, sign-offs and filler are drawn from pools shared by both classes

the URGENCY, PAYMENT, SECRECY and AUTHORITY sentence pools are SHARED between classes: a legitimate finance request and a fraudulent one are worded alike, so the text channel alone cannot decide the label

benign mail carries the LEGITIMATE form of properties that would otherwise be artifacts: IBANs on invoices, links to portals and intranets, Return-Path headers, executive titles in display names, and occasional consumer-mail contractors
deliberately_discriminative: BANKING_CHANGE_REQUEST - unsolicited bank-detail changes are the BEC payload and are genuinely rare in benign mail
LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN - a confusable domain has no benign explanation
why_these_controls: An earlier generation separated the classes perfectly on the authentication header alone, so every model and every ablation configuration scored 1.000 and the experiment could not distinguish evidence families. The compromised-account and relayed-benign controls model real phenomena that break that shortcut. A later generation additionally SHARED the urgency and payment sentence pools between classes, because drawing the two classes from disjoint vocabularies let a TF-IDF model recover the label from wording alone.
